svg.aria-label: Apple. Software Engineer Intern · Apple Online Store. Summer 2026. Built a recommendation & warning feature using Apple Intelligence and user behavioral data (React, JavaScript), cut LLM response latency by over 60%, and fixed 4 major production bugs affecting millions of users.
